description: Election Commission - Mr. B. M. U. W. B. Banneheka of the Kobeigane Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of the member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Kobeigane Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) has vacated their office, as declared by the Returning Officer under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with the status of an elected member of a local government body under electoral laws, making it clearly related to electoral processes.
